methodology: Wilson Score Interval without continuity correction (z = 1.959964)

monday_raw_rf_FPR.event_measured: Raw Random Forest classifies a benign flow as an attack class

monday_composite_FPR.event_measured: Composite predictor outputs non-BENIGN (1,328 Unknown + 45 Attack) on benign flow

monday_policy_FPR.event_measured: Policy engine assigns MONITOR or BLOCK to a benign flow

friday_ddos_raw_rf_FPR.event_measured: Raw RF classifies ambient Friday benign flow as DDoS or other attack

friday_ddos_raw_rf_recall.event_measured: Raw RF classifies a DDoS attack flow as DDoS (or any attack)

friday_ddos_policy_recall.event_measured: Policy engine assigns MONITOR or BLOCK to a DDoS flow

friday_portscan_raw_rf_FPR.event_measured: Raw RF classifies ambient Friday benign flow as PortScan or other attack

friday_portscan_raw_rf_recall.event_measured: Raw RF classifies a PortScan attack flow as PortScan (or any attack)

friday_portscan_policy_recall.event_measured: Policy engine assigns MONITOR or BLOCK to a PortScan flow
